definitions.explanation: A building or hall dedicated to the worship of a deity or deities. Used for both foreign temples (Greek, Egyptian, etc.) and the main hall of a Shinto shrine.

examples.japanese: ギリシャの{神殿|しんでん}を{訪|おとず}れた。
{古代|こだい}エジプトの{神殿|しんでん}が{発掘|はっくつ}された。
examples.english: An ancient Egyptian temple was excavated.

examples.japanese: {神殿|しんでん}の{柱|はしら}には{美|うつく}しい{彫刻|ちょうこく}が{施|ほどこ}されていた。
examples.english: The columns of the temple were adorned with beautiful carvings.

notes: Often used for foreign religious structures (パルテノン{神殿|しんでん}, ルクソール{神殿|しんでん}) and in Shinto context for the innermost sacred building ({本殿|ほんでん}/{神殿|しんでん}). For Buddhist temples, use {寺|てら}/{寺院|じいん}. For Shinto shrines as a whole, use {神社|じんじゃ}. {神殿|しんでん} specifically refers to the building structure where a deity is enshrined.
